This is a zero-dependency PHP 8.4 micro-framework. **CRITICAL**: This project uses **Podman Compose** (not Docker Compose). Always use `podman compose` commands. All PHP commands must run inside the `app` container.

**CRITICAL**: This project uses a **custom test runner**, NOT PHPUnit. The test runner is implemented in [src/Test.php](src/Test.php).
podman compose up -d
podman compose exec app php ajo test
podman compose exec app php ajo test --filter=Console
podman compose exec app php ajo test --parallel
podman compose exec app php ajo test --coverage
podman compose exec app php ajo test --coverage=coverage.xml
podman compose exec app php ajo test --log=junit.xml
podman compose exec app php ajo test:list
podman compose exec app php ajo migrate
podman compose exec app php ajo migrate:status
podman compose exec app php ajo migrate:rollback
podman compose exec app php ajo migrate:make create_users_table
podman compose exec app php ajo jobs:work
podman compose exec app php ajo help
podman compose exec app sh

Use `Test::suite()` and `Test::case()`; names use direct present tense, avoid “should”. Available assertions/hooks are defined in `src/Test.php`.

Each `src/` file contains Core instance implementation plus static Facade using singleton/container. Prefer instances in tests. Container supports `set`, `singleton`, `factory`, `get`, `has`.

Code must be DRY, simple, readable, robust, clever, performant. **CRITICAL**: This project is **pre-release**. There are **no backward compatibility constraints**. **Always update tests**. Prefer local closures, match, array functions, guard clauses, `??`, `?:`; avoid over-engineering and redundant private methods/types. Use PHP 8.4 features. Profile before optimizing; use native extensions/shared memory/atomic semaphores when justified.

**IMPORTANT**: This project has **Xdebug 3.4.6** installed and configured in the `app` container. Use the **xdebug-inspect skill**:
 /skill xdebug-inspect
podman compose exec app php debug_<issue>.php
See [.claude/skills/xdebug-inspect/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/xdebug-inspect/SKILL.md).
